purpose: Meshy 6 text-guided 4K PBR simplified graphic Foundry alternative on transform-baked GA-003

style.prompt: Stylized low-poly game PBR for this levitating Bulwark bot, readable at 41px. Clean graphic armor blocks, not photoreal. All body armor is medium-dark warm graphite or lighter ash-slate; recesses charcoal, never black. Add bold matte foundry lava-orange ceramic inset plates on 10% of the body. Broad hand-painted value variation and sparse chunky edge wear only. Satin-matte roughness, low metalness, no baked light. Avoid white or silver armor, greebles, labels, letters, numbers, decals, rust, soot, grime, micro-scratches, speckle, chrome, gloss, blue, cyan, green, red. Preserve UVs.
